question: Can small compensating changes in mass-scaled transition radius, concentration leakage, and Solar screening improve galaxy rotation, derived cluster lensing, and raw cluster topology together?

motivation.mass_radius_delta: largest local derived-cluster span and large galaxy span, but high values damage raw roots and Mercury
motivation.extent_leak: largest RXJ2129 raw span and recovers MACS1931 at +0.05, but worsens galaxy rotation
motivation.screen_exponent: dominant Solar lever and can compensate otherwise unsafe weak-field changes
motivation.prior_joint_test: no prior protocol crossed mass_radius_delta with extent_leak and screen_exponent

selection.galaxy_discovery: 91 SHA256-partition discovery galaxies, outer radii, fixed nuisance values
selection.solar_gate: Cassini, Earth, and Mercury proxies all pass
selection.root_gate: every raw-discovery held-out image root converges
selection.rank: maximize the minimum fractional gain across discovery galaxy, derived-cluster, and raw-lens equal-object RMS; tie by mean gain then smallest normalized step

transfer.source_positions: profiled independently on each formula's training images
transfer.MACS1931_rule: parent lacks one held-out root; report topology recovery separately and exclude it from matched parent RMS

factor_analysis.main_effect: span of level-mean gain for each coordinate
factor_analysis.pair_interaction: span of the two-factor cell residual after removing grand and both main effects
factor_analysis.purpose: rank leverage and compensation, not assign significance to an adaptive exploratory grid

claim_limits: The three coordinates were chosen after inspecting spent one-at-a-time sensitivity results.
The datasets and ordinary lens geometries are spent exploratory evidence.
CLASH acceleration targets and Tian baryonic profiles retain conventional reconstruction assumptions.
Fixed ordinary geometry isolates formula sensitivity but is not a new optimized lens fit.
The 64-setting grid performs model selection and is not a parameter-free prediction.
Solar diagnostics are analytic proxies rather than a full ephemeris likelihood.
